summary: The open AI model repository and developer inference ecosystem centers on Hugging Face as the dominant model hub, which surpassed 3 million public models in August 2026 and is adding over a million models per year, though downloads remain highly concentrated (the top 200 models account for ~49.6% of all downloads). Around this hub, a layer of developer-facing inference platforms—Ollama for local deployment and Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow for hosted serverless APIs—compete on speed, price-per-token, and model breadth. These are distinct from enterprise aggregators and MLOps platforms, focusing instead on giving individual developers and startups fast, pay-as-you-go access to open-weight models.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository for AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus hosted inference endpoints; serves as the de facto registry and distribution layer for open-source AI.
platforms.model_count: 3+ million public models (crossed 3M in August 2026, adding ~1M/year)
platforms.pricing: Free hosting for public models/datasets; PRO at ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and serverless Inference API billed by compute/usage; Enterprise Hub from ~$20/user/mo
features: Largest model, dataset, and Spaces hub
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who need to discover, share, fine-tune, or host open models and datasets.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local-first runtime for downloading and running open LLMs on your own machine with a simple CLI and local REST API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi variants)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source (self-hosted); no per-token cost, you supply the hardware
features: Quantized GGUF models for consumer GPUs/CPUs
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping or offline use.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform to run and deploy open models (especially image, video, audio, and LLMs) via a simple API without managing infrastructure.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models (Cog-packaged)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute/second of GPU/CPU time; some models priced per output/token
features: Run models with a single API call
Cog packaging for custom model deployment
Strong support for diffusion/image and video models
platforms.best_for: App developers and startups wanting to integrate open generative models (image/video/LLM) without managing GPUs.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance serverless inference and fine-tuning platform for open-source LLMs and multimodal models, with dedicated GPU clusters available.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; hourly pricing for dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters; fine-tuning billed per token/job
features: Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters for training
Broad catalog of chat, code, embedding, and image models
platforms.best_for: Startups and teams building production LLM apps that need scalable, low-cost open-model inference and fine-tuning.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Speed-optimized serverless inference platform for open and fine-tuned LLMs, vision, and audio models, targeting low latency and high throughput.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open models plus custom-deployed models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand GPU deployments billed hourly; fine-tuning charged per usage
features: LoRA fine-tuning and custom model hosting
platforms.best_for: Developers prioritizing low-latency, high-throughput production inference for open and fine-tuned models.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: Serverless inference platform offering a broad catalog of open models (strong in Chinese and multilingual models) at competitive pay-per-token pricing.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Llama, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; competitive low-cost tiers, with free quotas for select models
features: Strong support for leading Chinese open models
Text, image, audio, and video generation endpoints
Cost-efficient access to frontier open-weight models
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) needing affordable access to top Chinese and multilingual open models via a unified API.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: Ultra-low-latency inference platform running open LLMs on custom LPU (Language Processing Unit) hardware for exceptionally fast token generation.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek distills, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless; free developer tier with rate limits
features: Curated selection of popular open models
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time or latency-sensitive applications on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API router that aggregates hundreds of models from many open and closed providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models across dozens of providers (open and proprietary)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough with a small routing margin; no subscription required
features: Automatic fallback and provider load balancing
Price and latency transparency per model
Access to both open-weight and frontier closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want to compare, switch, or route between many model providers without separate integrations.
